blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Savouge booked its fourth straight win, but not after surviving a scare from the depleted Armed Forces of the Philippines, 25-22, 25-17, 32-34, 25-23, in the Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Tuesday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. AFP only played with eight players, missing key members Ranran Abdilla, James Buytrago, Nico Ramirez, Joshua Barrica and Jessie Lopez, while Jaidal Abdulmajid only saw action in the opening set but wasn’t able to return. But the Cavaliers stood their ground with Pol Salvador and Alfredo Pagulong, eking out a win in the neck-and-neck third set to force another set. READ: Spikers’ […]...
